mainText: Hello, Verona! At 2 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we have a temperature of 65 degrees and dense drizzle out near the Military Ridge State Trail.

The city is gearing up for pavement repairs on November 9 and 10 with work planned on Nine Mound Road, Morningside Boulevard, and Mozart Street. Also, we are pleased to announce that Deputy Chief Liz Gay has joined the Fitch Rona EMS team as of November 2 to oversee administration and operations.

There is plenty to do in our community today, including Hop Haus Trivia, Quizmasters Trivia at Lake Lou-ee, and Dream Day Trivia. Looking ahead to tomorrow, you can catch live music at Paddy Mac's, yoga at Insight Wellness, or Wednesday Pizza and a Pitcher at Lake Lou-ee.
In our weekly police report, we highlight an incident from October 25 where officers located a man passed out behind the wheel at Plympton Street and Rita Avenue, resulting in an arrest for O W I.
It is a great day to stop by Culver's for the flavor of the day, which is Turtle Cheesecake. The restaurant is currently open and will remain open for you until 10 PM tonight.
